scope.inputs: player-week box scores only (SRC-NFLVERSE-STATS, GSIS definitions SRC-NFL-GSIS); team points joined from the schedules feed (SRC-NFLVERSE-SCHED)
scope.excluded: no market price, no line, no model output enters any coefficient on this page

method.p_value: two-sided t approximation, normal limit above n=400
method.multiple_comparisons: not applied: these are descriptive measurements published with n, not hypothesis tests used to select a strategy. The strategy page applies BH/Bonferroni where selection happens.

qb_yards_vs_team_points.label: QB passing yards vs own team points

rb_yards_vs_team_points.label: RB1 rushing yards vs own team points

wr1_yards_vs_team_points.label: WR1 receiving yards vs own team points

rb_yards_vs_qb_yards.label: RB1 rushing yards vs QB passing yards

qb_yards_vs_opp_qb_yards.label: QB passing yards vs opposing QB passing yards

rush_yards_vs_pass_yards.label: Team rushing yards vs team passing yards

qb_yards_vs_wr1_yards.label: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards

qb_yards_vs_wr2_yards.label: QB passing yards vs WR2 receiving yards

wr1_vs_wr2_yards.label: WR1 receiving yards vs WR2 receiving yards

receptions_vs_receiving_yards.label: Receptions vs receiving yards (same player-game)
receptions_vs_receiving_yards.note: near-substitutes: do not price as independent legs

receptions_vs_targets.label: Receptions vs targets (same player-game)
receptions_vs_targets.note: control pair: a mechanically near-tautological relation that must come out high if the pipeline is sane

margin_vs_total.label: Absolute margin vs game total
margin_vs_total.note: control pair from the results feed, not the box score

parlay_pricing.definition: 4-leg parlay = QB-over + WR1-over (same game) in two independent games.

thresholds.rule: sample median, so each leg is a 50% proposition by construction

parlay_pricing.note: Multiplying four legs as if independent would price this parlay at the independent figure; the measured joint is the correct number because two legs share a game. The cross-game step IS an independence assumption and is labelled.

prop_combos.reason: No historical player-prop prices exist in any committed feed, so no combo can be priced or ROI-tested. The joint rates below are what a pricer needs.

combos.label: Receptions over X + receiving yards over Y (same player)
combos.pricing_implication: positive: independent pricing understates the joint, so the operator's adjusted price is the one that matters

combos.label: QB passing yards over X + WR1 receiving yards over Y (same game)
combos.pricing_implication: positive: independent pricing understates the joint, so the operator's adjusted price is the one that matters

combos.label: QB passing yards over X + WR2 receiving yards over Y (same game)
combos.pricing_implication: positive: independent pricing understates the joint, so the operator's adjusted price is the one that matters

combos.label: WR1 yards over X + WR2 yards over Y (same game)
combos.pricing_implication: positive: independent pricing understates the joint, so the operator's adjusted price is the one that matters
